name: Nová Paka (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a green band into a white upper fly part and a red lower hoist part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 2 September 1994 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
